capacities.description: Safe arrival and landing on the assigned runway.
Authorized emergency-vehicle movement on airport movement areas.
Runway occupancy awareness, clearance, and conflict prevention.
Emergency response capability independent of runway-conflict prevention.

facts: A scheduled passenger aircraft and an aircraft rescue/firefighting vehicle collided on runway 4 at a controlled airport during landing.
The investigation remained ongoing at the cutoff and the preliminary record was subject to change.
The airport diagram, ATC procedures, runway crossing rules, and airport certification/ARFF requirements predate the final outcome.
No final probable cause, contributing factor allocation, or recommendation is included.
identity_prompt: Specify which airport-surface safety and arrival capacities constitute the target system, and justify the boundary.
required_predictions: whether visible airport operations imply intrinsic continuity

sources.title: FAA Order JO 7110.65BB Air Traffic Control
